verdict.rationale: Phaser is a client-side game library, not an HTTP service. Its closest machine-readable API description is the full TypeScript definitions shipped in the npm package's types folder, which editors and tools can consume. However, probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec at any candidate path, and the hosted examples API (GET /api/v1/examples/{id}) has no published spec. Missing for 10: a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent schema document, a spec for the hosted examples API, and independent corroboration that the type definitions work as a machine-readable spec for agents.
